title: saga-definition template variables
description: Values for templates/saga-definition.md.j2 and templates/saga-definition.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from saga-definition.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

coordination_style.title: Coordination style
coordination_style.description: Does one component drive the steps, or does each service react to the previous event? Orchestration is easier to debug; choreography couples less. Pick one - a mix is neither.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator
orchestrator.description: Which engine runs the orchestration? Write n/a when the style above is choreography, so a reader knows the field was answered and not skipped.

outbox_topic.title: Outbox topic
outbox_topic.description: Which topic prefix does CDC publish this saga's outbox rows to? The events land on `<prefix>.events`, so pick a prefix a consumer can subscribe to without guessing.

saga_name.title: Saga name
saga_name.description: Which business transaction does this saga complete? Name the outcome a customer would recognise - place-order, not order-service-workflow-2.

step_1_action.title: Step 1 action
step_1_action.description: What does that first step actually do, in the domain's words rather than the API's?

step_1_compensation.title: Step 1 compensation
step_1_compensation.description: What undoes that first step? It must be idempotent and it must be runnable when the forward step's own service is the one that failed.

step_1_service.title: Step 1 service
step_1_service.description: Which service executes the first step? Steps beyond the first follow the same shape - add a row each, with its own compensation.
